The Last Blade Master'' |author=[[Ryder Windham]] |cover artist=[[Jeffery Carlisle]] |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=Canceled |intl release= |rereleased= |media type= |pages= |isbn= |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline= |series=''[[Star Wars: Adventures in Hyperspace]]'' |preceded by=[[Adventures in Hyperspace: The Big Switch|''The Big Switch'']] |followed by= }} '''''Adventures in Hyperspace: The Last Blade Master''''' was the planned fourth and final volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Adventures in Hyperspace]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] young-reader series, which follows the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The book was to be written by [[Ryder Windham]], illustrated by [[Jeffery Carlisle]], and published by [[Scholastic]] Although [[Lucasfilm]] approved Windham's synopsis for ''The Last Blade Master'', the book was ultimately canceled along with the series' third volume, [[Adventures in Hyperspace: The Big Switch|''The Big Switch'']]. The approved synopsis is now available on author [[Joseph Bongiorno]]'s fan site, [http://www.starwarstimeline.net/AdventuresinHyperspace.htm The ''Star Wars'' Expanded Universe Timeline].
